1991 Data Fellows joining and virus reverse engineering are supported by public self-authored career announcement and 2022 interview. Thirty-four years is company/predecessor tenure, not necessarily full tenure as CRO.

1994 first company website is explicitly a retrospective recollection in the 2022 interview, not proof of inventing web technology or first security website globally.
